name: com.birjuvachhani.locus.LocationBroadcastReceiver
description: Locus, Birju Vachhani's Android location library, receives updates from Android's location service and delivers the latest position to the app. It runs when the app has requested ongoing location updates.
disableEffect: Disabling it stops those location updates from reaching the app, which can break features that rely on current location or location tracking.
